item.title: Week of November 2, 2026 — the 2026 AHA/ACC pulmonary embolism guideline, and ICRAKI (first full episode)
item.description: Two segments: the AHA/ACC acute PE guideline's five clinical categories (and Kate's LMWH-lead-in question answered by category), then ICRAKI — intermittent haemodialysis vs CRRT as the first renal replacement in ICU AKI, stopped early for higher mortality with intermittent. Intro: ADA/EASD 2026 type 2 and type 1 diabetes consensus reports, carvedilol in cirrhosis, tozorakimab for COPD, a Halifax co-author on the AVERT post hoc, flu season week 43. Quiz on the type 2 consensus.
item.content:encoded:
Two segments: the AHA/ACC acute PE guideline's five clinical categories (and Kate's LMWH-lead-in question answered by category), then ICRAKI — intermittent haemodialysis vs CRRT as the first renal replacement in ICU AKI, stopped early for higher mortality with intermittent. Intro: ADA/EASD 2026 type 2 and type 1 diabetes consensus reports, carvedilol in cirrhosis, tozorakimab for COPD, a Halifax co-author on the AVERT post hoc, flu season week 43. Quiz on the type 2 consensus.

Show notes

Segment 1 — Creager MA, et al. 2026 AHA/ACC/ACCP/ACEP/CHEST/SCAI/SHM/SIR/SVM/SVN guideline for the evaluation and management of acute pulmonary embolism in adults. Circulation 2026;153:e977–e1051. doi:10.1161/CIR.0000000000001415. Digest card: pe-aha-acc-2026 (https://claude.ai/artifact/6xnFzaohkVktcRSN57WB4s).

Segment 2 — Gaudry S, et al. Intermittent or continuous renal-replacement therapy in acute kidney injury (ICRAKI). N Engl J Med 2026;395:1677-1690. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2608397. Digest card: icraki-nejm-2026.

Mark's sources — Segment 1: M Velia Antonini (FOAMcc) thread on bsky.app summarising the guideline (categories C3–D transfer; sedation for intubation in C–E), spring 2026; AJR review headline via @ajrradiology (Sept 2026). Segment 2: none read beyond the paper — bets logged as hunches.

Intro items — ADA/EASD 2026 type 2 diabetes consensus (Diabetologia, doi:10.1007/s00125-026-06855-7); ADA/EASD 2026 type 1 diabetes consensus (Diabetologia, doi:10.1007/s00125-026-06833-z); Simon TG, et al. Ann Intern Med 2026;179:1117 (carvedilol; Journal Watch Editor's Pick, reviewer R. Ganatra); Sciurba FC, et al. N Engl J Med 2026;395:1703-16 (tozorakimab); Feng NL, et al. Cancer Med 2026;15:e72423 (AVERT post hoc, Dal co-author S. Shivakumar); PHAC FluWatch+ week 43.

Quiz answer — an SGLT2 inhibitor or/and a GLP-1-based therapy, potentially from diagnosis (ADA/EASD 2026 type 2 diabetes consensus).

item.title: Week of October 26, 2026 — EPCAT III: aspirin alone after hip or knee arthroplasty (pilot)
item.description: Pilot episode: Liz, Mark and Maggie on the Halifax-led EPCAT III trial (aspirin alone non-inferior to rivaroxaban-then-aspirin after arthroplasty), the week's headlines — Hypertension Canada 2025, SODa-BIC, Hydra, the AGA C. diff update, NHS-Galleri — and a one-question quiz.
item.content:encoded:
Pilot episode: Liz, Mark and Maggie on the Halifax-led EPCAT III trial (aspirin alone non-inferior to rivaroxaban-then-aspirin after arthroplasty), the week's headlines — Hypertension Canada 2025, SODa-BIC, Hydra, the AGA C. diff update, NHS-Galleri — and a one-question quiz.

Segment: Shivakumar S, Matino D, Zukor D, et al. Rivaroxaban then aspirin vs. aspirin alone after total hip or knee arthroplasty (EPCAT III). N Engl J Med, published online July 12, 2026. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2603649 (correction: N Engl J Med 2026;395:728). Digest card: https://claude.ai/artifact/6xnFzaohkVktcRSN57WB4s (week of October 26, 2026 — epcat-iii-2026).
Mentioned in the intro: Hypertension Canada 2025 (CMAJ 2025;197:E549); SODa-BIC (N Engl J Med 2026;395:1062); Hydra (JAMA 2026, doi 10.1001/jama.2026.13384); AGA C. difficile clinical practice update (Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2026;24:2359); NHS-Galleri (N Engl J Med 2026;395:1374).
Mark's sources: none this episode — the Journal Watch review was behind the subscriber wall, the editorial and expert commentary were not opened; all speculation labelled "total guess here".
Quiz answer: hypertension = BP ≥130/80 mm Hg (validated device, standardised method); target systolic <130 mm Hg if tolerated (Hypertension Canada 2025).
